name: My views
description: A radio player in the sidebar: SomaFM's stations, the song on now, play, previous, next and favorites.

scopes.net:somafm.com: Read SomaFM's stations and the song each one plays now.
scopes.actions:run: Play a station in a cmux browser tab.
scopes.browser:read: See whether the stream tab is open, so the player knows it plays.
scopes.browser:write: Move the stream tab to the next station instead of opening a second one.
scopes.storage:local: Remember your station and your favorites.
